# Ryan Ardian

> Fullstack Software Engineer & DevOps / Network Specialist

## Summary
I am a Fullstack Software Engineer, DevOps Engineer, and Network Infrastructure Specialist with extensive experience designing, developing, and deploying mission-critical systems across software, virtualization, and networking layers.

My engineering focus centers on high-throughput backend architectures with Laravel and Hono.js, reactive frontends using React and TypeScript, and enterprise-grade infrastructure. On the DevOps & server orchestration side, I specialize in bare-metal and cloud virtualization using Proxmox VE and VMware ESXi, Docker containerization, VPS fleet management, Linux server hardening, and Cloudflare edge services (R2, Hyperdrive, Turnstile, Tunnels).

In addition to building scalable web applications and POS platforms, I actively serve as an Informatics Educator at SMA Negeri 1 Gedeg, mentoring the next generation in computer science, DevOps workflows, and hands-on MikroTik & virtualization lab environments.

## Featured Projects & Case Studies
### AKAS V2 - Academic Security System (2026)
- **Category:** Academic Security App
- **Status:** Private - Active Development
- **Tech:** Laravel 11, React SPA, Inertia.js, TailwindCSS, Cloudflare R2
- **Description:** A comprehensive school discipline & academic monitoring platform. Migrated from legacy PHP Native monolith to modern Laravel API + React SPA architecture with Google OAuth, Cloudflare R2, and Progressive Web App support.
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/ardianryan
- **Case Study Page:** https://ardianryan.com/projects/akas

### Satenya Mama Loesye - POS & Management System (2026)
- **Category:** POS & Catering System
- **Status:** Live
- **Tech:** React, Hono.js, Prisma ORM, TypeScript, Docker
- **Description:** Point of Sales & catering management system with a bold neobrutalist UI. Features Kitchen Display System synchronization, dynamic QRIS generation, WhatsApp OTP authentication, and delivery radius validation.
- **Live App:** https://satenyamamaloesye.ppti.me
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/ardianryan
- **Case Study Page:** https://ardianryan.com/projects/satenya

### ScholarGate SSO - Portal & CMS (2026)
- **Category:** SSO & School CMS
- **Status:** Private - Active
- **Tech:** Laravel, React, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2, OAuth2
- **Description:** Central school education portal and CMS designed for shared-hosting or VPS. Supports Google OAuth SSO, portable JSON data backups, and multi-database configurations.
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/ardianryan
- **Case Study Page:** https://ardianryan.com/projects/scholargate

### SIEKSA V3 - School Extracurricular System (2026)
- **Category:** Extracurricular Panel
- **Status:** Private - Active
- **Tech:** React, TypeScript, Hono.js, PostgreSQL, Docker
- **Description:** Web-based extracurricular administrative panel managing student directories, meeting logs, performance metrics, and automated achievement verification.
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/ardianryan
- **Case Study Page:** https://ardianryan.com/projects/sieksa

## Network Infrastructure & Labs
- **Cloud Services**: Edge networks, global DNS routing, and secure object storage for project assets. (Cloudflare R2, Cloudflare DNS, WAF)
- **MikroTik RouterOS**: Core routing, firewall rules, user session management, and traffic queueing policies. (VLANs, QoS Bandwidth Mgmt, WireGuard VPN)
- **Managed Switch**: Local ethernet aggregation segmenting server VLANs from client networks. (L2/L3 Switching, Trunk Ports, Network Isolation)
- **Application Server**: Hosting web services like AKAS v2, ScholarGate SSO, and Satenya Mama Loesye. (Laravel 11+, React SPA, Hono.js POS, Docker)
- **Database Node**: Structured storage nodes for school achievements, POS transactions, and user credentials. (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Prisma ORM)
- **Client Stations**: End-user devices accessing school systems and POS cashier clients. (WiFi Captive Portal, POS Terminals, PWA Devices)
